construct_optimizer: construct an SGD, Adam, or AdamW optimizer for a PyTorch model with per-parameter weight decay
get_epoch_lr: get the learning rate for a given epoch based on the configured LR policy and warmup schedule
set_lr: set the learning rate on all parameter groups of a PyTorch optimizer to a new value
plot_lr_fun: plot and visualize the learning rate schedule across all training epochs using matplotlib
get_lr_fun: retrieve the configured LR policy function such as steps, cosine, linear, or exponential
